title: Gloss Leaderboard Document
description: One computed top-N list at plugins/Gloss/leaderboards/<id>.json, sampled by Gloss and readable as leaderboard.<id>.* from every surface.

placeholder.description: Required for type papi. A PlaceholderAPI token, with or without the % wrapper.

statistic.description: Required for type statistic. A Bukkit Statistic name such as PLAY_ONE_MINUTE.

material.description: Required when the statistic is keyed by a block or item.

entity.description: Required when the statistic is keyed by an entity type.

key.description: Required for type metric. Refused at load until a plugin publishes per-player metric groups.

size.description: Ranked entries kept; also clamped by [leaderboards] maxEntries.

reset.description: Period boundary in UTC. All-time totals are kept alongside the period bucket.

includeOffline.description: Keeps the last sampled value for players who are not online.

value.description: Rendered once per recompute. Reads value and name.

name.description: Rendered once per recompute. Reads value and name.
